rule: One name per player: the day-to-day half as an adjective, then the people archetype as the noun.
Override the default only when a clearly better phrase exists (redundancy, awkward sound, a known phrase).
Every name carries one line under it that merges both halves, in both voices (fun and heart).

glue.why: Clearest and least hurtful noun across all 8 adjectives in both the bare-name and on-card runs, the only people noun that passes the gate on its own (clear 4.94, hurt 1.39, would-post 3.78, 18 readers), gender-neutral. Group Anchor read as holding the group back or a news anchor (clear 3.1 to 3.2); Group Mom was clearest in meaning but hurt 3.2 (gender, parent role).
glue.exception: Cozy Group Host for the Cozy cell (see overrides).

overrides.name: Certified Free Spirit
overrides.why: Spontaneous and Free Spirit say the same thing twice. Certified is the clever fix with the lowest hurt (1.33); Unstoppable, the first idea, read as reckless (hurt 1.94, lowest clarity). Spontaneous Free Spirit stays the fallback: clearest, but redundant.

overrides.name: Cozy Group Host
overrides.why: Cozy Team Captain read as a sports captain who stays home (clear 3.67); Cozy Group Host names what this player does (hosts every holiday) and scored clear 4.39, hurt 1.0 in the same run.

gate.name: clear >= 4.5, hurt <= 2 (scored on the card, with the fun line printed under the name)
gate.panel: Codex cold-reader panel of 6 readers aged 20 to 35, US and Canada (progressive activist, religious conservative, ESL speaker, Gen Z TikTok user, nurse, engineer); 18 readers (3 shuffled runs) for every final score

rounds.what: first draft: 64 names bare, 7 Glue nouns x 8 adjectives, 4 Free Spirit alternatives, 128 lines, 100 tells
names on the card with the line under them, 3 more Glue nouns, rewrites
full final set rescored: 64 names on card, 9 nouns alone as baseline, 128 lines, 100 tells
rewrites of the f1 failures, Go-To Friend probe, Cozy Group Host check
